item.title: The Company Lab Launches CO.LAB Q for Quantum Startups
item.summary: Insider Brief Press release – The Company Lab (CO.LAB) today announced CO.LAB Q, a 12-month quantum commercialization studio designed to help promising startups and research teams turn advanced technologies into scalable, market-ready companies. Applications are now open, and the program begins in November 2026. Built around the Tennessee Valley’s concentration of industry expertise and real-world […]
